title: MINOR: make sure all fiedls of o.p.k.s.a.Action are NOT null
body:
I'm migrating Ranger's kafka plugin from deprecated Authorizer (this is already removed by 976e78e405d57943b989ac487b7f49119b0f4af4)  to new API (see https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/RANGER-3231). The kafka plugin needs to take something from field `resourcePattern` but it does not know whether the field is nullable (or users need to add null check). I check all usages and I don't observe any null case.
